_doc: Per-article end-of-content CTA routing high-intent finance/privacy library readers to the sister product, Muntin Ledger (https://ledger.muntin.digital). Stamped by scripts/inject-ledger-cta.mjs as a <aside class="post-end-cta"> between <!-- ledger-cta:start --> / <!-- ledger-cta:end -->, inserted AFTER the existing tool post-end-cta + smart-next blocks so it reads as the final 'and here is the product' step. The link is a plain external anchor (passes link equity to Ledger) carrying Plausible's declarative class API (plausible-event-name=Ledger+Route+Click, plausible-event-source=<slug>) so the click fires the registered 'Ledger Route Click' event with a bounded source prop; this also suppresses Plausible's automatic outbound-link event on the same click, so there is no double-count. EN + ES per article; the ES block stamps into es/library/<slug>/ when it exists, otherwise that locale is skipped. No invented numbers — copy describes only what Muntin Ledger's own pages already state (reads invoices with templates and rules, searchable ledger, clean CSV export, posts to QuickBooks Online).

restaurant-menu-engineering.headline_en: Menu engineering needs live plate costs.
restaurant-menu-engineering.headline_es: La ingeniería de menú necesita costos de plato vivos.
restaurant-menu-engineering.body_en: The quadrants only mean something if the cost column is current. Muntin Ledger reads your vendor invoices as they arrive and files them searchable, so the plate-cost number you engineer against is this week's, not last quarter's.
